{{Quote|Right, you alien scum. Everybody get up against the wall! This is a raid!|The Sith soldier|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith soldier''' served under [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] fought against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3956 BBY]], the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] was stationed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], which had recently been captured and [[Destruction of Taris|blockaded]] by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. A few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] began, he conducted a raid on the [[South Apartments]] of the [[Upper City]], accompanied by two [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

When a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Ixgil|resident]] objected to his searches, the [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] soldier shot him with his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. However, the event was witnessed by [[Republic soldier]]s [[Carth Onasi]] and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], the latter of whom was also an [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] former [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. The Sith soldier realized that they were Republic fugitives and ordered his battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to attack, but the duo was able to defeat the two droids and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the soldier.

==Biography==
{{Quote|What's this? Humans hiding out with aliens? They're Republic fugitives! Attack!|The Sith soldier discovers Revan and Carth Onasi|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
[[File:ThisIsARaid.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Sith soldier with his blaster rifle drawn]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] served under [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] fought between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="KotOR" /> In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the Sith sent a large [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to capture [[Taris/Legends|Taris]],<ref name="KotOR" /> an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> member [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the Republic. The fleet intercepted and ambushed the Republic [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|cruiser]] ''[[Endar Spire]]'' upon its arrival in the [[Taris system/Legends|system]], and, although the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was destroyed, several [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were able to survive by fleeing to the surface in [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]; two such men were Republic war hero [[Carth Onasi]] and fellow [[Republic soldier|soldier]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who was actually an [[Amnesia/Legends|amnesiac]] former Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the Sith.<ref name="KotOR" /> After the battle, the Sith instituted an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Destruction of Taris|blockade]] of Taris to prevent any of the surviving Republic forces from escaping.<ref name="db">{{DB|character|canderousordo|Ordo, Canderous}}</ref> The Sith soldier was part of an occupation force that was stationed planet-side to restore local order and hunt down any remaining Republic personnel.<ref name="KotOR" />

A few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the battle, the soldier, accompanied by two [[sentinel droid]]s, raided the [[South Apartments]] of the [[Upper City]], the highest levels of the Taris [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]]. Onasi and Revan, who were hiding in the apartments, were leaving their room when they found the soldier arguing with two [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] residents. When one of the Duros, [[Ixgil]], complained about the Sith's frequent raids on the building, the soldier shot him in the chest with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] him. The soldier then noticed Onasi and Revan and, recognizing them as Republic fugitives, ordered his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] to attack while he engaged the [[Unidentified Duros (South Apartments)|remaining Duros]]. The soldier and his [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were unable to defeat their enemies and were killed as a result. The second Duros thanked Revan for saving his life and expressed his hope that no more Sith would come to cause trouble. He then promised to move the soldier's body elsewhere to throw any investigators off the track.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|&laquo;There was a patrol here just yesterday, and they found nothing! Why do the Sith keep bothering us?&raquo;''"<br />"''[Shoots Ixgil] That's how we Sith deal with smart-mouth aliens! Now the rest of you get up against the wall before I lose my temper again!|Ixgil and the Sith soldier|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
The Sith soldier was an aggressive and [[Humanocentrism|humanocentric]] individual, referring to [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] as "scum." He was also prone to anger, which caused him to react violently to situations, such as when he shot Ixgil for complaining. However, the soldier was able to successfully deduce that Onasi and Revan were Republic fugitives upon seeing them in the South Apartments, which had a largely alien population. The soldier had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and dark skin.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Skills and abilities==
In addition to speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]], the Sith soldier was able to understand<ref name="KotOR" /> [[Durese/Legends|Durese]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the [[Language/Legends|language]] of the Duros [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was able to wield a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle, although he was unable to defeat Onasi and Revan, even with help from his two battle droids.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Equipment==
During his raid on the South Apartments, the Sith soldier carried a blaster rifle and a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]] while wearing the gray [[Sith Empire uniforms|uniform]] typical of Sith soldiers not equipped with [[Sith trooper armor/Legends|armor]]. He used the backpack to store a [[Fragmentation grenade/Legends|frag grenade]], a [[Poison gas grenade/Legends|poison grenade]], an [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] strength [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]], and an adrenal stamina stimulant.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith soldier first appears as a non-player character in [[BioWare]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'',<ref name="KotOR" /> a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2003]]<ref name="kotorxbox">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2003/07/15/star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic-review-2|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Review|author=Boulding, Aaron|date=2003-07-13|work=IGN.com|archivedate=20130111082256}}</ref> and for [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] on [[November 18]], 2003.<ref name="kotorpc">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2003/11/22/star-wars-knights-of-the-old-republic-review|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Review|author=Boulding, Aaron|date=2003-11-21|work=IGN.com|archivedate=20121017052437}}</ref> The character is featured in one of the early scenes on the planet Taris, the first planet the player visits after escaping the ''Endar Spire''. The player encounters the Sith soldier after leaving the player's apartment hideout for the first time. The player does not have an opportunity to interact with the scene between the soldier and the two Duros until the Sith soldier identifies Onasi and the player as Republic fugitives and orders his droids to attack. There is no possibility of avoiding the fight, which occurs regardless of the player character's gender or alignment in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After the soldier has been defeated, the player can loot the soldier's remains to obtain his blaster rifle and the equipment contained in his backpack.<ref name="KotOR" />

In the cutscene, a number of quotes are said differently from the dialogue subtitles. In the first case, the subtitles read as "Okay you alien scum," but the voice actor clearly says, "Right, you alien scum." In the second case, the subtitles read "Hey, what's this?" instead of the spoken "What's this?" These discrepancies are not present in the Xbox version of the game, in which a different voice actor portrays the soldier.<ref name="KotOR" />
